osaDaya ayusmatis ta adBirayusmatis tasa.s: ozaDaya AyuzmatIs tA adBirAyuzmatIs tAsAmayam AyuzAyuzmAn astvasO

osaDayo diksa taya somo raja diksaya dik.s: ozaDayo dIkzA tayA somo rAjA dIkzayA dIkzitaH

osaDiByaH pasuByo me Danaya (Ts. pasave.s: ozaDIByaH paSuByo me DanAya (TS. paSave no janAya)

osaDiByas tan nirBajamo yosman dveswi ya.s: ozaDIByas taM nirBajAmo yo'smAn dvezwi yaM vayaM dvizmaH

osaDis te lomani sisacantu yatuDana svah.s: ozaDIs te lomAni sizacantu yAtuDAna svAhA
